attributes.name: Druva - Consecutive Backup Failures
attributes.description: Detects resources that experience repeated backup failures during the detection window.
author: Druva

meta.customer_usecase: Detects resources that experience repeated backup failures during the detection window.

attributes.query:
FROM logs-druva.event-*
| EVAL event_text = TO_LOWER(COALESCE(TO_STRING(message), TO_STRING(druva.event_type), ""))
| EVAL resource = COALESCE(
    TO_STRING(druva.resource.name),
    TO_STRING(druva.resource.name),
    TO_STRING(user.name)
  )
| EVAL event_time = @timestamp
| WHERE resource IS NOT NULL AND event_text LIKE "*backup failed*"
| STATS
    failure_count = COUNT(*),
    first_failure = MIN(event_time),
    last_failure = MAX(event_time),
    failure_details = VALUES(TO_STRING(message))
  BY resource
| WHERE failure_count >= 3
